text_block_list.text:
One of her target races this year was the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). However—as per 
usual—Gold Ship was acting bizarre.

Ho-ho-ho! A highborn lady's laughter 
echoed across the paddock. Having mastered 
an array of refined etiquette, Gold Ship 
had transformed into a truly noble 
Umamusume.

Standing in her way is Eishin Flash. For 
the sake of victory, for the sake of the 
keyword, Gold Ship dances gracefully—no, 
dashes forward!
